about: Every rebuilt function, for the website: no code (that is on GitHub, at file and lines). Generated from reports/verified_registry.json by portal/tools/registry_outputs.py.

reset.note: Every function is rebuilt and verified again from scratch. The earlier work is in git history (tag pre-reset-2026-11-08).

xb:0x00251310.what: The archive name hash: skips one leading backslash, then hash * 31 + each character (signed, 0x20 added below 'a'); 0 for null.

xb:0x0029A2F0.what: Works out a shader's blend mode (a fading solid surface blends) and its alpha reference: ACTH times the opacity, kept to 0..1.

xb:0x0029A390.what: Sets a shader's BLMD setting, then works out its blend mode and alpha reference again (sub_0029A2F0).
